'''Zug Tassik''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] criminal with [[Color/Legends|gray]] and blue skin and purple [[eye]]s.<ref name="TCWs4BR3" /> By [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Legends-Date">{{TCWdates|420}}</ref> a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] with a 300,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] reward had been placed on Tassik for mass [[Death/Legends|murder]]. The bounty listing included the Trandoshan's last known position and specified that they could be brought in [[Death/Legends|dead]] or alive. <ref name="Revenge" />

Several [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] viewed Tassik's bounty on a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]]  as they discussed their next target while they were at a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]<ref name="Revenge" /> on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. A [[Unidentified Balnab bounty hunter|Balnab bounty hunter]] dismissed Tassik's bounty along with several others as being too easy before they discovered a bounty for the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|darksider]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]].<ref name="Revenge" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zug Tassik's image first appeared on a building on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in "[[Bounty (episode)|Bounty]]," an episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. Their image was first seen in close-up in the episode "[[Revenge (episode)|Revenge]]." Tassik was identified in the [[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|episode guide]] of "Revenge" on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="Revenge Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/revenge-trivia-gallery|text="Revenge" Trivia Gallery}}</ref>
